participation.context: Read the two words, and the names above and below, and the two words again.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Put the book in his hands, and kept a finger at the margin.
participation.name: Richard Field

participation.context: Found the leaf with a stubby thumb.
participation.name: John Harrison

story.body: You took the margin, and you left the rest of the note where it was, too small.

participation.context: Read the two words, shut the book gently, and did not buy it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Gave it standing, said the poems, and said thou for the aside.
participation.name: Richard Field

participation.context: Counted two customers, and kept the stock.
participation.name: John Harrison

relations.note: the margin is for the poems, by his account

story.body: You read the margin standing. You answered Field about the poems and the players. You left the book on the stall, and you left the Holinshed where the cat has it.

relations.note: the margin is for the poems, by his account

title: Read the margin and shut the book gently

participation.context: Stood at the stall, and did not bring the page away.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: His finger at the margin. His face is not in it.
participation.name: Richard Field

participation.context: His hand at the corner of the leaf. His face is not in it.
participation.name: John Harrison

story.body: You stood over the leaf long enough for the finger to mark it. The picture does not keep the words.

title: Stood over Field's finger on a note too small to read

story.body: You turned the word over two ways, set your age beside a man you have never seen, and laughed with your shoulders on the way home.

title: Tried the word sweet on the way into Cheapside
